tasks.title: Create AreaPlanEditor.h with basic properties
tasks.description: Design and implement the AreaPlanEditor.h header file, establishing all fundamental properties required for area planning, such as areaWidth, areaHeight, lineSpacing, numPoints, missionAltitude, and areaCenter. Ensure these properties are accessible and modifiable for integration with the rest of the system.
tasks.details: Develop the header file with Q_PROPERTY declarations for each core property, enabling Qt's property system and QML bindings. Include all necessary QGroundControl (QGC) and Qt positioning headers. Add the Q_OBJECT macro and ensure the class inherits from the appropriate Qt base class. Implement clear and concise getter and setter methods for each property, following best practices for encapsulation and maintainability. Document each property and method for clarity.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the header compiles without errors, all Q_PROPERTY declarations are present and correct, and that the properties are accessible from QML and C++.

tasks.title: Create AreaPlanEditor.cc with geodesic calculations
tasks.description: Develop the AreaPlanEditor.cc implementation file, focusing on robust geodesic calculations and efficient grid generation algorithms to support area planning and mission creation.
tasks.details: Implement advanced geodesic calculation methods using Qt's geographic and positioning libraries to accurately compute distances, bearings, and midpoints on the Earth's surface. Develop grid generation algorithms that create a structured set of points within the defined area, supporting various mission patterns. Add comprehensive area movement methods (North, South, East, West, Center) to allow dynamic repositioning of the planned area. Integrate waypoint calculation logic that translates grid points into mission waypoints, considering altitude and other mission parameters. Ensure all algorithms are optimized for performance and accuracy.
tasks.testStrategy: Test geodesic calculations with a variety of known coordinate pairs to ensure mathematical correctness. Validate that grid generation produces the expected number and arrangement of waypoints for different parameter sets. Confirm that area movement methods update the area center as intended.

subtasks.title: Implement geodesic calculation methods using Qt positioning
subtasks.description: Develop precise geodesic calculation methods to determine distances, bearings, and midpoints between two geographic coordinates, accounting for the Earth's curvature.
subtasks.details: Utilize Qt's geographic library to perform all necessary calculations. Implement and thoroughly test formulas for distance, bearing, and midpoint computations, ensuring accuracy for both small and large distances. Provide utility functions for reuse throughout the codebase.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with a comprehensive set of known coordinates and compare results to established geodesic calculators to verify correctness.

subtasks.title: Add grid generation algorithms
subtasks.description: Design and implement algorithms to generate a grid of points within the defined area, based on user-specified parameters such as area size, line spacing, and number of points.
subtasks.details: Leverage geodesic calculation methods to accurately determine the coordinates of each grid point. Develop efficient data structures for storing and retrieving grid points, ensuring scalability for large grids. Support different grid patterns if required (e.g., rectangular, hexagonal).
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the generated grid matches the expected layout and parameters for a variety of input configurations. Check for edge cases such as minimal and maximal area sizes.

subtasks.title: Implement area movement methods
subtasks.description: Create methods to move the defined area in the four cardinal directions (North, South, East, West) as well as to recenter it, allowing for flexible area adjustment.
subtasks.details: Use geodesic calculations to determine the new center coordinates after each movement. Implement logic to ensure smooth and predictable transitions between grid points, and handle boundary conditions gracefully.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test area movement with a variety of scenarios, including edge cases near the poles and the international date line, to ensure correct and expected behavior.

subtasks.title: Add waypoint calculation logic
subtasks.description: Develop algorithms to convert grid parameters and area movement results into a sequence of mission waypoints, ready for use in flight planning.
subtasks.details: Utilize geodesic methods to compute the precise coordinates of each waypoint. Implement data structures for efficient storage and retrieval of waypoints, and ensure that waypoints are generated in the correct order for mission execution.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the generated waypoints align with the grid and area parameters, and that their sequence matches the intended mission path.

subtasks.title: Implement grid parameter handling
subtasks.description: Develop robust logic to manage and validate grid parameters, including line spacing and the number of points per line, ensuring user inputs are correctly processed.
subtasks.details: Use geodesic calculations to determine the impact of parameter changes on grid layout. Implement validation routines to prevent invalid or out-of-range parameter values. Store grid parameters efficiently for quick access and updates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with a wide range of grid parameter values to ensure correct handling, validation, and grid regeneration.

tasks.title: Register the C++ class in QGC's QML system
tasks.description: Integrate the AreaPlanEditor C++ class into QGroundControl's QML system, enabling seamless property bindings and interaction between the C++ backend and QML frontend.
tasks.details: Add the necessary class registration code in the appropriate QGC module, ensuring that the AreaPlanEditor class is exposed to QML with the correct type name and version. Test that all properties and methods are accessible from QML, and that property bindings work as expected. Document the registration process for future reference.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that QML can access all C++ properties and methods through the registered class, and that property changes in QML are reflected in C++ and vice versa.

tasks.title: Test basic property bindings
tasks.description: Thoroughly test the property bindings between the QML frontend and the C++ AreaPlanEditor backend to ensure reliable two-way communication and data synchronization.
tasks.details: Create test QML components that read and write all AreaPlanEditor properties, including area dimensions, spacing, and center. Test area movement functions from QML and verify that changes are propagated to the backend. Ensure that all signal/slot connections are functioning correctly and that property changes trigger the appropriate updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Develop a simple test QML application that exercises all property bindings and movement functions, confirming that changes in either QML or C++ are immediately reflected in the other.

tasks.title: Add area width/height controls to existing UI
tasks.description: Enhance the AreaPlanEditor.qml user interface by adding intuitive controls for adjusting the area width and height, providing users with direct manipulation of area dimensions.
tasks.details: Integrate width and height SpinBox controls into the existing UI, binding them to the corresponding C++ backend properties. Ensure that changes made through the UI are immediately reflected in the backend and that any updates from the backend are shown in the UI. Provide input validation and user feedback for out-of-range values. Ensure that changes to area dimensions trigger recalculation of the grid and waypoints.
tasks.testStrategy: Test that adjusting the SpinBox controls updates the C++ properties in real time and that all dependent calculations and visualizations are refreshed accordingly.

tasks.title: Add line spacing and points per line controls
tasks.description: Expand the user interface to include controls for line spacing and the number of points per line, allowing users to fine-tune the grid layout for their mission area.
tasks.details: Connect new or existing SpinBox controls for line spacing and points per line to the corresponding C++ backend properties. Implement robust input validation to prevent invalid values and provide clear feedback to users. Ensure that changes to these controls result in immediate updates to the grid and waypoint calculations, maintaining synchronization between the UI and backend.
tasks.testStrategy: Test that modifying the line spacing and points per line controls updates the grid calculations in real time and that the UI remains responsive and accurate.

tasks.title: Add directional movement buttons
tasks.description: Introduce directional movement buttons (North, South, East, West, Center) to the UI, enabling users to reposition the mission area with a single click.
tasks.details: Connect each directional movement button to the corresponding C++ backend movement method. Ensure that all five directions (N, S, E, W, Center) are supported and that the area center is updated correctly in response to user input. Provide visual feedback for movement actions and ensure that all dependent calculations and visualizations are updated accordingly.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each movement button individually and in sequence, verifying that the area center coordinates change as expected and that the UI and backend remain in sync.

tasks.title: Test all controls update backend properties
tasks.description: Conduct comprehensive testing to ensure that all UI controls correctly update the corresponding C++ backend properties and trigger the necessary recalculations and visual updates.
tasks.details: Systematically test each UI control, including area dimensions, line spacing, points per line, and movement buttons, to confirm that changes are propagated to the backend and that all dependent calculations and visualizations are refreshed. Check for edge cases and invalid inputs, ensuring robust error handling and user feedback.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform systematic testing of each control, verifying that backend properties are updated correctly and that the system responds appropriately to all user actions.

tasks.title: Add area rectangle visualization to existing map
tasks.description: Integrate a dynamic area rectangle visualization into the QGC map system, leveraging AreaPlanEditor's properties and methods to provide real-time feedback on the defined mission area.
tasks.details: Develop a MapPolygon component that visually represents the area rectangle on the map. Bind the polygon's geometry to AreaPlanEditor's areaWidth, areaHeight, and areaCenter properties to ensure real-time updates as parameters change. Integrate the visualization into QGC's existing map system (likely within PlanView.qml), adhering to established visualization patterns for consistency. Use the AreaPlanEditor's calculateOffsetCoordinate method to accurately compute the rectangle's corners based on the current center, width, and height. Ensure that the MapPolygon updates automatically through property bindings whenever any area parameter changes. Apply QGC's standard MapPolygon styling and interaction patterns for a seamless user experience. The rectangle should be clearly visible and update instantly as users adjust area parameters via the UI.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the area rectangle appears on the map, updates in real time as area parameters change, and accurately reflects the defined area.

subtasks.title: Create MapPolygon component for area rectangle
subtasks.description: Develop a MapPolygon component that visually displays the area rectangle on the map, utilizing the AreaPlanEditor's calculateOffsetCoordinate method for precise geodesic calculations of the rectangle's corners.
subtasks.details: Ensure the MapPolygon is styled according to QGC standards and is easily distinguishable from other map elements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that the rectangle is rendered correctly and matches the specified area parameters.

subtasks.title: Bind MapPolygon to AreaPlanEditor properties
subtasks.description: Establish property bindings between the MapPolygon and AreaPlanEditor's areaWidth, areaHeight, and areaCenter properties to enable real-time updates.
subtasks.details: Ensure that any change in area parameters immediately updates the MapPolygon geometry on the map.
subtasks.testStrategy: Modify area parameters and verify that the MapPolygon updates without delay.

subtasks.title: Ensure real-time MapPolygon updates
subtasks.description: Implement mechanisms to guarantee that the MapPolygon visualization updates instantly whenever AreaPlanEditor properties change, maintaining synchronization between the UI and map.
subtasks.details: Test for performance and responsiveness, especially during rapid parameter changes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Rapidly change area parameters and observe the MapPolygon for lag or update issues.

subtasks.title: Integrate MapPolygon with QGC map system
subtasks.description: Embed the MapPolygon component into QGC's existing map system (likely in PlanView.qml), following established visualization and interaction patterns for consistency and usability.
subtasks.details: Ensure the area rectangle integrates seamlessly with other map elements and supports user interactions as needed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the integrated visualization in the full QGC environment for compatibility and usability.

tasks.title: Add grid lines visualization
tasks.description: Implement a clear and responsive grid lines visualization on the map, providing users with a visual representation of the planned mission grid within the defined area.
tasks.details: Develop grid lines visualization using MapPolyline components, displaying parallel lines within the area rectangle based on the current line spacing parameter. Ensure that the grid lines are calculated using AreaPlanEditor's geodesic methods for accuracy and are rendered as MapPolyline elements on the map. Each line should span the full width of the area and be spaced according to the lineSpacing parameter. The visualization must update in real time as area parameters change, maintaining alignment with the area rectangle. Use the calculateOffsetCoordinate method to compute the precise endpoints of each grid line. Style the grid lines to be visually distinct from the area boundary, providing a clear indication of the mission path. Follow QGC's established MapPolyline styling and interaction patterns for consistency.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that grid lines are rendered correctly, update instantly when the line spacing or area parameters change, and remain visually distinct and accurate.

tasks.title: Add waypoint markers visualization
tasks.description: Add a comprehensive waypoint markers visualization to the map, displaying all mission waypoints along the generated grid lines for enhanced mission planning clarity.
tasks.details: Implement waypoint markers using MapQuickItem or a similar component, placing markers at each calculated waypoint along the grid lines according to the points per line parameter. Ensure that the markers are computed using AreaPlanEditor's geodesic methods and are positioned accurately on the map. The visualization should update in real time as any area or grid parameter changes. Use the calculateOffsetCoordinate method to determine the exact position of each waypoint. Style the markers to be visually distinct, and consider using different marker styles for start, end, and intermediate waypoints to aid user understanding. Follow QGC's MapQuickItem styling and interaction conventions for a consistent user experience.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that waypoint markers appear at the correct positions, update immediately when parameters change, and are clearly distinguishable on the map.

tasks.title: Test real-time map updates
tasks.description: Perform thorough testing of all map visualizations to ensure that changes to any area or grid parameter result in immediate and accurate updates to the map, maintaining a seamless user experience.
tasks.details: Conduct comprehensive testing of all map elements, including the area rectangle, grid lines, and waypoint markers, to confirm that any change in parameters (width, height, spacing, points per line) is instantly reflected in the visualizations. Test for performance and responsiveness, especially during rapid or simultaneous parameter changes. Identify and resolve any synchronization or update issues.
tasks.testStrategy: Change each parameter individually and in combination, verifying that all map elements update immediately and accurately, with no lag or visual artifacts.

tasks.title: Implement waypoint generation algorithm
tasks.description: Design and implement a robust waypoint generation algorithm that creates mission waypoints based on the current grid parameters, ensuring compatibility with QGC's mission planning system.
tasks.details: Develop an algorithm that generates waypoints from the defined grid parameters, including area size, line spacing, and points per line. Convert the resulting grid points into QGC mission waypoints, ensuring that each waypoint includes all necessary information such as coordinates and altitude. Implement logic for proper waypoint sequencing to optimize mission execution and handle altitude settings as required. Ensure the algorithm is efficient and scalable for large grids, and document the process for future maintenance.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the generated waypoints match the expected grid positions, are correctly sequenced, and conform to QGC's mission format. Test with a variety of grid configurations.

subtasks.title: Define Grid Parameters
subtasks.description: Identify, document, and validate all grid parameters required for waypoint generation, such as the number of rows, columns, and the size of each grid cell.
subtasks.details: Determine the mathematical relationships between area dimensions, line spacing, and the resulting grid structure. Ensure all parameters are validated for correctness and usability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with a range of parameter values to confirm correct grid structure and parameter validation.

subtasks.title: Implement Waypoint Generation Algorithm
subtasks.description: Develop and optimize the algorithm that generates waypoints from the defined grid parameters, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
subtasks.details: Use C++ (or the appropriate language) to implement the algorithm, leveraging geodesic calculations for precise waypoint placement. Ensure the algorithm can handle various grid sizes and configurations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the algorithm with different grid setups and compare the output to expected waypoint layouts.

subtasks.title: Convert Grid Points to QGC Mission Waypoints
subtasks.description: Translate each grid point into a QGC mission waypoint, ensuring compatibility with QML integration and QGC's mission execution requirements.
subtasks.details: Utilize Qt and QML integration to expose the generated waypoints to the frontend. Ensure each waypoint includes all required attributes, such as latitude, longitude, and altitude.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that waypoints are correctly formatted and accessible from QML, and that they can be used in QGC's mission planning workflow.

subtasks.title: Handle Proper Waypoint Sequencing and Altitude Settings
subtasks.description: Implement logic to ensure that waypoints are sequenced in the optimal order for mission execution and that altitude settings are correctly applied to each waypoint.
subtasks.details: Use appropriate data structures (e.g., arrays or lists) to store and manage waypoint information. Implement sorting or sequencing algorithms as needed, and ensure altitude is set according to mission requirements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with various mission scenarios to confirm correct waypoint order and altitude assignment.

tasks.title: Add mission upload functionality
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive mission upload functionality, enabling users to transfer generated waypoints to connected vehicles through QGC's mission upload system.
tasks.details: Integrate with QGC's mission upload system by connecting to its API and establishing a secure, reliable connection for uploading waypoints. Implement the uploadToVehicle() method in AreaPlanEditor to facilitate seamless mission transfer. Handle all aspects of the upload process, including authentication, data encryption, and error handling. Provide clear feedback to users on upload status and handle error conditions gracefully, including retries and notifications. Ensure compatibility with vehicle communication protocols such as MAVLink, and implement data encoding and decoding as required. Document the integration process and provide comprehensive testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test mission upload to a connected vehicle, verifying that waypoints are received correctly and that the system handles errors and status updates appropriately.

subtasks.title: Integrate with QGC's mission upload system
subtasks.description: Establish a secure and reliable connection to QGC's mission upload API, implementing all necessary authentication, encryption, and error handling mechanisms.
subtasks.details: Research QGC's mission upload architecture, API endpoints, authentication methods, and error handling procedures. Implement the integration in AreaPlanEditor, ensuring seamless interaction with QGC's mission upload workflow.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify successful connection establishment, secure data transfer, and correct handling of authentication and errors.

subtasks.title: Implement waypoint upload functionality
subtasks.description: Develop the mechanism for uploading generated waypoints to connected vehicles, ensuring data is transmitted in the correct format and sequence.
subtasks.details: Use the established API connection to send waypoint data, adhering to QGC's mission file and communication standards. Ensure the upload process is robust and provides user feedback.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that waypoints are correctly received and processed by the connected vehicle, and that upload progress is accurately reported.

subtasks.title: Handle upload status and error conditions
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling for mission upload failures, including automatic retries, user notifications, and detailed logging for troubleshooting.
subtasks.details: Leverage API-provided error codes and implement custom logging to ensure a seamless and user-friendly experience during mission uploads.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate various error conditions and verify that the system responds appropriately, providing clear feedback and recovery options.

subtasks.title: Integrate with vehicle communication protocols
subtasks.description: Establish and maintain communication channels with connected vehicles using standardized protocols such as MAVLink, ensuring reliable data transfer.
subtasks.details: Implement all necessary data encoding, decoding, and transmission logic according to the chosen protocol. Ensure compatibility with a range of vehicle types and firmware versions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test data transfer with different vehicle configurations, verifying correct reception and interpretation of mission data.

subtasks.title: Test mission upload functionality
subtasks.description: Conduct thorough testing of the entire mission upload workflow, from area definition and waypoint generation to successful upload and execution on the vehicle.
subtasks.details: Use a combination of unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure reliability and a seamless user experience. Document all test cases and results.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify correct mission execution and vehicle behavior for a variety of mission scenarios.

tasks.title: Add mission file saving
tasks.description: Implement robust mission file saving capability, allowing users to export and store generated missions in standard file formats for later use or sharing.
tasks.details: Develop functionality to save generated missions to files, supporting all standard mission file formats used by QGC and compatible systems. Implement thorough file handling routines, including file selection dialogs, overwrite protection, and error checking. Ensure that saved files can be reliably loaded back into QGC or other compatible software. Provide clear user feedback on save operations and handle any file system errors gracefully.
tasks.testStrategy: Test saving missions to various file formats and locations, then reload them into QGC to verify correctness and compatibility.

tasks.title: Test complete mission workflow
tasks.description: Perform end-to-end testing of the complete mission workflow, from initial area definition through waypoint generation and mission upload, ensuring all components work together seamlessly.
tasks.details: Test the entire workflow, starting with area definition and parameter adjustment, proceeding through grid and waypoint generation, and culminating in mission upload to a connected vehicle. Verify that all steps are integrated correctly, that data flows smoothly between components, and that the user experience is intuitive and error-free. Identify and resolve any integration issues or workflow bottlenecks.
tasks.testStrategy: Execute a complete workflow test: define an area, generate waypoints, upload the mission to a vehicle, and verify correct mission execution and feedback at each stage.

tasks.title: Add error handling and validation
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling and input validation across all components, ensuring robust operation and clear user feedback in the face of invalid inputs or unexpected conditions.
tasks.details: Add thorough validation for all user inputs and parameters, including range checks, type validation, and logical consistency. Handle edge cases and unexpected conditions gracefully, providing user-friendly error messages and guidance for resolution. Ensure that all errors are logged for troubleshooting and that the system remains stable under all conditions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with a wide variety of invalid inputs and edge cases, verifying that errors are handled gracefully and that the user receives clear, actionable feedback.

tasks.title: Add progress indicators
tasks.description: Introduce progress indicators for long-running operations, such as waypoint generation and mission upload, to keep users informed and improve the overall user experience.
tasks.details: Implement progress indicators in the UI for all operations that may take significant time, such as generating large grids or uploading missions to vehicles. Provide real-time feedback on operation status, including estimated completion times where possible. Ensure that progress indicators are responsive and accurately reflect the current state of the operation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test progress indicators during long operations, verifying that they update in real time and provide accurate, helpful feedback to users.

tasks.title: Performance optimization
tasks.description: Optimize the performance of all real-time updates and calculations, ensuring smooth and responsive UI interactions even with large mission areas and complex grids.
tasks.details: Profile and optimize all performance-critical code paths, including grid and waypoint generation, map visualizations, and UI updates. Implement caching, efficient data structures, and algorithmic improvements as needed to maintain real-time responsiveness. Test with large and complex mission scenarios to identify and resolve any performance bottlenecks.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct performance testing with a variety of parameter combinations and mission sizes, ensuring that the UI remains smooth and responsive at all times.

tasks.title: Final testing and bug fixes
tasks.description: Carry out comprehensive final testing and resolve any remaining bugs, ensuring that all features are stable, reliable, and ready for production deployment.
tasks.details: Perform exhaustive system testing, covering all features, workflows, and edge cases. Identify and fix any remaining bugs or inconsistencies. Ensure that all components work together seamlessly and that the user experience is polished and intuitive. Prepare the system for release by completing all necessary documentation and final quality checks.
tasks.testStrategy: Execute complete system testing with a wide range of scenarios and edge cases, verifying that all features function correctly and that the system is free of critical bugs.

tasks.title: Power System Verification
tasks.description: Verify all power system components are properly configured and functioning for safe flight operations.
tasks.details: Ensure battery is fully charged, voltage and capacity are verified through Mission Planner, and all battery connectors are securely attached. This is critical for flight safety and mission success.
tasks.testStrategy: Test battery voltage under load, verify capacity readings, and ensure secure connections before flight.

subtasks.title: Battery fully charged
subtasks.description: Ensure the flight battery is fully charged and ready for flight operations.
subtasks.details: Charge battery to 100% capacity and verify charge completion. Check for any signs of damage or swelling.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify battery voltage reads 4.2V per cell when fully charged.

subtasks.title: Battery voltage & capacity verified
subtasks.description: Verify battery voltage and capacity through Mission Planner > Initial Setup > Battery Monitor.
subtasks.details: Connect to Mission Planner and verify battery voltage and capacity readings are accurate and within expected ranges.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that voltage readings match expected values and capacity is sufficient for planned mission.

subtasks.title: Battery connectors securely attached
subtasks.description: Ensure all battery connectors (e.g., XT60/XT90) are properly connected and secure.
subtasks.details: Check that battery connectors are fully seated and locked in place. Verify no loose connections or exposed wires.
subtasks.testStrategy: Gently tug on connectors to ensure they are secure and will not disconnect during flight.

tasks.title: Radio & GPS Signal Verification
tasks.description: Verify radio communication and GPS signal quality for reliable flight control and navigation.
tasks.details: Ensure RC transmitter link is stable, telemetry radio link is established, GPS fix is acquired, and all failsafes are properly configured. Note: This may not be valid for current test scenarios.
tasks.testStrategy: Test radio link stability, verify GPS fix quality, and confirm all failsafe configurations are active.

subtasks.title: RC transmitter link stable
subtasks.description: Ensure RC transmitter link is stable with RSSI > 90%.
subtasks.details: Check that RC transmitter link is stable and signal strength is above 90% for reliable control.
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor RSSI values and ensure they remain above 90% during pre-flight checks.

subtasks.title: Telemetry radio link established
subtasks.description: Establish telemetry radio link between Ground and Air systems.
subtasks.details: Ensure telemetry radio link is established and stable for ground control station communication.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify telemetry data is being received and transmitted properly.

subtasks.title: GPS fix acquired
subtasks.description: Ensure GPS fix is acquired (3D Fix or better) for accurate positioning.
subtasks.details: Wait for GPS to acquire a 3D fix or better for accurate positioning and navigation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor GPS status until 3D fix is achieved with sufficient satellite count.

subtasks.title: HDOP and satellite count verified
subtasks.description: Verify HDOP < 1.5 and Satellites > 10 for optimal GPS accuracy.
subtasks.details: Check that HDOP is below 1.5 and satellite count is above 10 for optimal GPS positioning accuracy.
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor HDOP and satellite count until both criteria are met.

subtasks.title: GPS/Compass alignment verified
subtasks.description: Verify GPS and compass alignment for accurate heading information.
subtasks.details: Ensure GPS and compass are properly aligned and calibrated for accurate heading information.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform compass calibration and verify alignment with GPS heading.

subtasks.title: No GPS glitches or jumps
subtasks.description: Ensure no GPS glitches or position jumps are occurring.
subtasks.details: Monitor GPS position for any glitches or sudden position jumps that could indicate GPS issues.
subtasks.testStrategy: Observe GPS position for several minutes to ensure stable readings.

subtasks.title: All failsafes configured
subtasks.description: Configure all failsafes (RC Loss, GCS Loss, Battery FS) for safety.
subtasks.details: Ensure all failsafes are properly configured including RC Loss, GCS Loss, and Battery failsafe settings.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each failsafe condition to ensure proper response and recovery behavior.

tasks.title: Sensor Quality & Calibration
tasks.description: Verify sensor quality and perform necessary calibrations for accurate flight control.
tasks.details: Calibrate accelerometers, compass, test for compass interference, and verify EKF status for optimal sensor performance.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform all sensor calibrations and verify EKF status is clear of warnings or high variances.

subtasks.title: Accelerometers calibrated
subtasks.description: Calibrate accelerometers on a flat surface for accurate orientation detection.
subtasks.details: Perform accelerometer calibration on a perfectly flat surface to ensure accurate orientation detection.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify accelerometer readings are consistent and accurate after calibration.

subtasks.title: Compass calibrated
subtasks.description: Calibrate compass (external preferred) for accurate heading information.
subtasks.details: Perform compass calibration, preferably using an external compass, for accurate heading information.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify compass readings are accurate and consistent after calibration.

subtasks.title: Compass interference tested
subtasks.description: Test for compass interference by arming and observing drift.
subtasks.details: Arm the vehicle and observe compass readings for any drift or interference that could affect navigation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor compass readings during arm/disarm cycles to detect any interference.

subtasks.title: EKF status OK
subtasks.description: Ensure EKF status is OK with no warnings or high variances.
subtasks.details: Check that the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) status is clear of warnings or high variances for optimal navigation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor EKF status and ensure all variances are within acceptable limits.

tasks.title: Flight Controller & Software Setup
tasks.description: Verify flight controller firmware and software configuration for proper operation.
tasks.details: Ensure ArduPilot firmware is up to date, correct frame type is selected, PID tuning is tested, flight modes are configured, and failsafe behavior is verified.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all software configurations are correct and test basic flight controller functionality.

subtasks.title: ArduPilot firmware up to date
subtasks.description: Ensure ArduPilot firmware is up to date for latest features and bug fixes.
subtasks.details: Check that ArduPilot firmware is the latest version with all recent features and bug fixes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify firmware version and update if necessary.

subtasks.title: Correct frame type selected
subtasks.description: Ensure correct frame type (Quad) is selected in the flight controller.
subtasks.details: Verify that the correct frame type (Quad) is selected in the flight controller configuration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check frame type setting and verify it matches the actual vehicle configuration.

subtasks.title: PID tuning roughly tested
subtasks.description: Test PID tuning to ensure stable flight characteristics.
subtasks.details: Perform basic PID tuning tests to ensure the vehicle has stable flight characteristics.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test hover stability and basic flight maneuvers to verify PID settings.

subtasks.title: Flight modes configured
subtasks.description: Configure flight modes (Stabilize, Loiter, RTL, etc.) for different flight scenarios.
subtasks.details: Set up and configure all necessary flight modes including Stabilize, Loiter, RTL, and others as needed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each flight mode to ensure proper switching and behavior.

subtasks.title: Failsafe behavior verified
subtasks.description: Verify failsafe behavior is set and tested for safety.
subtasks.details: Ensure all failsafe behaviors are properly set and tested for safe operation in emergency situations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each failsafe condition to ensure proper response and recovery.

tasks.title: Motors & ESCs Verification
tasks.description: Verify motor and ESC functionality for safe and reliable flight.
tasks.details: Ensure all motors spin in correct direction, props are installed correctly, temperatures are normal, no unusual vibration, and ESCs are calibrated.
tasks.testStrategy: Test motor direction, prop installation, temperature monitoring, vibration analysis, and ESC calibration.

subtasks.title: All motors spin in correct direction
subtasks.description: Verify all motors are spinning in the correct direction for proper flight control.
subtasks.details: Check that each motor is spinning in the correct direction according to the frame configuration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each motor individually to verify correct rotation direction.

subtasks.title: Props installed correctly
subtasks.description: Ensure props are installed correctly (CW/CCW) for proper thrust generation.
subtasks.details: Verify that props are installed in the correct orientation (CW/CCW) for proper thrust generation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check prop orientation and ensure they match the motor rotation direction.

subtasks.title: Motor & ESC temperature normal
subtasks.description: Verify motor and ESC temperatures are normal after spin testing.
subtasks.details: Check that motor and ESC temperatures remain within normal operating ranges after spin testing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor temperatures during and after motor testing to ensure they stay within safe limits.

subtasks.title: No unusual vibration or sound
subtasks.description: Ensure no unusual vibration or sound from motors or props.
subtasks.details: Check for any unusual vibration or sound that could indicate mechanical issues with motors or props.
subtasks.testStrategy: Listen and feel for any unusual vibrations or sounds during motor testing.

subtasks.title: ESCs calibrated
subtasks.description: Ensure all ESCs are properly calibrated for consistent motor response.
subtasks.details: Perform ESC calibration to ensure all motors respond consistently to throttle inputs.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test throttle response across all motors to verify consistent ESC calibration.

tasks.title: Electrical Integrity Check
tasks.description: Verify electrical system integrity for safe operation.
tasks.details: Check for short circuits, verify BEC voltage output, and ensure battery voltage/current logs are OK in hover test.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform electrical system checks and verify voltage/current readings during hover test.

subtasks.title: No short circuits or overheating
subtasks.description: Check for any short circuits or overheating spots in the electrical system.
subtasks.details: Inspect the electrical system for any short circuits or overheating components that could cause failures.
subtasks.testStrategy: Visually inspect all electrical connections and monitor component temperatures.

subtasks.title: BEC voltage output verified
subtasks.description: Verify BEC voltage output is within acceptable range.
subtasks.details: Check that the Battery Eliminator Circuit (BEC) voltage output is within acceptable range for flight controller and servos.
subtasks.testStrategy: Measure BEC output voltage and ensure it remains stable under load.

subtasks.title: Battery voltage/current logs OK
subtasks.description: Ensure battery voltage/current logs are OK in hover test.
subtasks.details: Monitor battery voltage and current during hover test to ensure they remain within acceptable ranges.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform hover test and analyze voltage/current logs for any anomalies.

tasks.title: Telemetry & Logs Setup
tasks.description: Configure telemetry and logging systems for flight monitoring and analysis.
tasks.details: Insert SD card, enable logging, configure log types, and verify GCS/OSD shows live data including voltage, current, GPS, and RSSI.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify logging is enabled and all telemetry data is being recorded and displayed properly.

subtasks.title: SD card inserted and logging enabled
subtasks.description: Insert SD card and enable logging for flight data recording.
subtasks.details: Insert SD card into the flight controller and enable logging to record flight data for analysis.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify SD card is properly inserted and logging is enabled in the flight controller.

subtasks.title: Log types configured
subtasks.description: Configure log types (IMU, GPS, BAT, RC, etc.) for comprehensive data recording.
subtasks.details: Configure which data types to log including IMU, GPS, battery, RC, and other relevant flight data.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all desired log types are enabled and recording properly.

subtasks.title: GCS/OSD shows live data
subtasks.description: Verify GCS/OSD shows live: Voltage, Current, GPS, RSSI.
subtasks.details: Ensure Ground Control Station (GCS) and On-Screen Display (OSD) show live data including voltage, current, GPS status, and RSSI.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that all live data is being displayed correctly in GCS and OSD.

tasks.title: Mechanical Structure Verification
tasks.description: Verify mechanical structure integrity for safe flight operations.
tasks.details: Tighten frame bolts, secure landing gear, balance props, install vibration dampening, and balance center of gravity.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform mechanical inspections and ensure all structural components are properly secured and balanced.

subtasks.title: Frame bolts tightened
subtasks.description: Ensure all frame bolts are properly tightened for structural integrity.
subtasks.details: Check and tighten all frame bolts to ensure structural integrity and prevent loosening during flight.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use appropriate tools to verify all frame bolts are properly tightened.

subtasks.title: Landing gear secured
subtasks.description: Ensure landing gear is properly secured to the frame.
subtasks.details: Check that landing gear is properly attached and secured to the frame for safe landings.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify landing gear attachment and test for any looseness or movement.

subtasks.title: Props balanced
subtasks.description: Balance props to reduce vibration and improve flight stability.
subtasks.details: Balance all props to minimize vibration and improve overall flight stability and performance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use prop balancer to ensure all props are properly balanced.

subtasks.title: Vibration dampening in place
subtasks.description: Ensure vibration dampening is properly installed for smooth operation.
subtasks.details: Check that vibration dampening materials are properly installed to reduce vibration transmission.
subtasks.testStrategy: Inspect vibration dampening installation and test for effectiveness.

subtasks.title: Center of Gravity balanced
subtasks.description: Balance the center of gravity for optimal flight characteristics.
subtasks.details: Ensure the center of gravity is properly balanced for optimal flight characteristics and stability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test CG balance and adjust if necessary for optimal flight performance.

tasks.title: Ground Station & Companion Computer Setup
tasks.description: Configure ground station and companion computer for mission control and monitoring.
tasks.details: Connect GCS, ensure companion computer boots and connects, verify camera/streaming functionality, and verify MAVLink routing.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all ground station components are connected and functioning properly.

subtasks.title: GCS connected
subtasks.description: Ensure Ground Control Station (GCS) is connected and communicating.
subtasks.details: Connect and verify Ground Control Station is properly connected and communicating with the vehicle.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test GCS connection and verify data communication is working.

subtasks.title: Companion computer boots and connects
subtasks.description: Ensure companion computer boots properly and establishes connection.
subtasks.details: Verify that companion computer boots successfully and establishes proper connection with the flight controller.
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor companion computer boot process and verify connection status.

subtasks.title: Camera/Streaming working
subtasks.description: Verify camera and streaming functionality (if applicable).
subtasks.details: Test camera functionality and video streaming if applicable for the mission requirements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test camera feed and streaming quality if camera is part of the mission.

subtasks.title: MAVLink routing verified
subtasks.description: Verify MAVLink routing is working properly for communication.
subtasks.details: Ensure MAVLink routing is properly configured and working for reliable communication between components.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test MAVLink communication and verify routing is functioning correctly.

tasks.title: Optional Pre-Flight Tests
tasks.description: Perform optional pre-flight tests for comprehensive system verification.
tasks.details: Perform bench hover test, ESC output PWM check, arm/disarm behavior test, vibration analysis, and verify all logs are clear.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform comprehensive pre-flight tests to verify all systems are functioning properly.

subtasks.title: Bench hover test
subtasks.description: Perform bench hover test (~15s) for logs and system verification.
subtasks.details: Perform a brief hover test (~15 seconds) to generate logs and verify system functionality.
subtasks.testStrategy: Conduct hover test and analyze generated logs for any issues.

subtasks.title: ESC output PWM check
subtasks.description: Check ESC output PWM signals for proper motor control.
subtasks.details: Verify that ESC output PWM signals are within proper ranges for motor control.
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor ESC PWM outputs and ensure they are within expected ranges.

subtasks.title: Arm/disarm behavior test
subtasks.description: Test arm/disarm behavior to ensure proper safety functions.
subtasks.details: Test arm and disarm behavior to ensure proper safety functions are working correctly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test arm/disarm sequence and verify proper behavior and safety functions.

subtasks.title: Vibration analysis
subtasks.description: Check vibration (VIBE.X/Y/Z) within safe limits (<30).
subtasks.details: Analyze vibration levels in all axes and ensure they are within safe limits (<30).
subtasks.testStrategy: Monitor vibration levels and ensure they remain below safe thresholds.

subtasks.title: Logs verification
subtasks.description: Verify logs: CTUN, BAT, GPS all clear.
subtasks.details: Check that all relevant logs (CTUN, BAT, GPS) are clear of errors or warnings.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review all logs and ensure they are clear of any errors or concerning patterns.
